title: acb operator configuration
description: Operator-supplied checker configuration (--config, default ./.acb.yaml relative to the working directory). Never read from inside the scanned PATH.

exclude.description: Paths under PATH removed from discovery. Every exclusion is reported in the output with its reason.

instruction_files.description: Additional files under PATH evaluated as instruction files (e.g. an agent prompt that is not named AGENTS.md).
